question: How is the covenant-covering structured and what world lies above it?
premises: The covenant-covering encloses the covering of Ananta within five worlds.
Above the covenant-covering lies the auspicious-Shiva realm.
In that realm is the great world named Sadakhya.
inference: The covenant-covering contains Ananta's domain and gives way upward to the great Sadakhya world in the auspicious-Shiva realm.
uncertainties: The precise internal arrangement of the five worlds is not spelled out.
plain_english: The covenant-covering encloses the covering of Ananta within five worlds. Above it lies the auspicious-Shiva realm, and there is the great world called Sadakhya.
